s: Why AI chatbots state false things with confidence, how the way models are trained and scored rewards guessing, and what to check before you trust an answer.
k: A federal appeals court wants a person to check every AI-drafted citation. Days later, two AI labs said their new models make fewer things up. Chatbots sound sure when they're wrong partly because they're scored like students who never lose a point for guessing.
